children.name: Gisekia africana  Kuntze
children.description: The native range of this species is S. Somalia to N. Kenya, S. Tanzania (incl. Zanzibar) to S. Trop. & S. Africa, Hainan to Indo-China. It is a annual or subshrub and grows primarily in the seasonally dry tropical biome.

children.name: Gisekia diffusa M.G.Gilbert
children.description: The native range of this species is Ethiopia to N. Kenya. It is a annual and grows primarily in the desert or dry shrubland biome.

children.name: Gisekia haudica M.G.Gilbert
children.description: The native range of this species is E. Ethiopia to Somalia. It is a annual and grows primarily in the desert or dry shrubland biome.

children.name: Gisekia paniculata Hauman
children.description: The native range of this species is DR Congo. It is a annual and grows primarily in the seasonally dry tropical biome.

children.name: Gisekia pharnaceoides L.
children.description: The native range of this species is Africa to Indo-China. It is a annual and grows primarily in the desert or dry shrubland biome.

children.name: Gisekia polylopha M.G.Gilbert
children.description: The native range of this species is Somalia. It is a annual and grows primarily in the desert or dry shrubland biome.

children.name: Gisekia scabridula M.G.Gilbert
children.description: The native range of this species is Somalia. It is a perennial and grows primarily in the desert or dry shrubland biome.
